decisions.reason: Grounded in host-boot-log.txt and browser-error.txt: the boot-composed combo is one classic script, so a single compile error stops all 53 registrations, and the named typert-registry entry is correctly explained as the first awaited innocent victim, with no claim that ESM is invalid everywhere.

Bisecting insert rows, the ModuleLoader.load({id, factory}) shell, package-name identity, host React via require inside the factory, and inject/apply exports are all correct and fixture-grounded; but the primary static check offered is node --check alone, which the contract says can accept ESM and is insufficient, and no forced classic-script parse (vm.Script or equivalent) is described — only a grep fallback for ESM tokens.

Uses plugin-apply-error.txt and the bare register in client.js to explain owner declaration and undefined apply ordering, shows the exact ctx.slots.inject('settings.section', () => ctx.slots.register(...)) wrapper, and gives the correct field rule (name/id/order plus optional label, never kind/scope).

Grounded in host-boot-log.txt and restart-notes.txt: combo composed once at boot so edits and refresh cannot rebuild it, full stop/start plus refresh and plugin-list verification each iteration, taskkill tree kill on Windows, and EADDRINUSE explained as the orphaned old process holding the port.

Proposes per-bundle classic-script validation at assembly and install time plus attribution via the failing artifact path mapped to its package instead of the first awaited entry, and a checklist covering the loader factory, host-provided React, inject/apply exports, deferred cross-entry slot registration, field whitelist, and restart/Windows tree cleanup.

caps.reason: Final advice consistently requires the inject wrapper, forbids kind/scope and bare top-level ESM, and makes a full host restart mandatory; the migration-hygiene refresh note is raised only as a caveat explicitly subordinated to the observed boot-composed host, not relied upon.
